description: This is a PHP source file defining a REST API endpoint class 'PerformanceTrackerLogAPI' within the OrangeHRM system. The class manages CRUD operations for performance tracker logs, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting logs. It leverages traits for authentication, service access, validation, and date/time handling. The class uses PHPDoc annotations for API documentation and validation rules, specifying API paths, parameters, and responses.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogAPI
classes.description: This class handles CRUD operations for performance tracker logs via REST API endpoints, including listing, creating, copying, updating, and deleting logs. It integrates authentication, validation, and service traits, and uses annotations for API documentation and validation rules.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all performance tracker logs for a specific tracker, including counts of positive and negative achievements. Supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new performance tracker log with details such as achievement, comment, and log message, associating it with a tracker and current user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified logs from a performance tracker, ensuring user has access rights.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single performance tracker log by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance tracker log with new details.

methods.name: setTrackerLogsParams
methods.description: Sets log details from request parameters into a PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Returns validation rules for common request body parameters such as log message, achievement, comment, ensuring length constraints and valid values.
